jobs.description: Welcome to Rhenus!The Rhenus Group is one of the leading global logistics service providers. Throughout the entire supply chain, we offer tailored solutions for companies across a wide range of industries. From multimodal transportation and optimal warehousing to seamless customs clearance and innovative value-added services, we stay at the forefront of industry developments and work closely alongside our customers every step of the way.What you can expect:- In this position, you will receive, review and process ad-hoc pricing requests from both the global network and own-controlled customers - including the clarification of customer requirements, if needed.- In addition, you will work closely with local operations and sales to understand customer needs, apply pricing according to local price sensitivity, and support the execution of margin and pricing strategies.- You will foster exchange with the Airfreight Pricing & Procurement Team (e.g., for shipment solutions over 1.5 tons) and the Gateway Team in Frankfurt to develop competitive and operationally feasible solutions.- Furthermore, you will ensure thorough documentation of all quotations and provide insightful reporting to local P&L responsible parties, local sales, the airfreight product team, and the Gateway.- Last but not least, you will be responsible for the follow-up on all provided spot quotations and related inquiries - ensuring feedback is received, success rates are monitored through standard reporting, and coordination with the Commercial Team is maintained. You will also follow customer-specific pricing instructions precisely.What you bring:- You have already gained previous experience in airfreight operations or sales, providing a solid foundation in industry processes and commercial dynamics.- A self-reliant working style combined with the ability to perform well under pressure in time-sensitive environments is one of your key strengths.- You have a confident and professional demeanor in negotiations and in communication with both customers and suppliers.- Naturally, you bring a strong numerical understanding and a sharp eye for detail, supporting accurate and data-driven decision-making.- Business fluency in English, along with strong verbal and written communication skills, round off your profile.Your benefits:- Cafeteria: Fuel your day with nutritious meals at our on-site cafeteria.- Continuous Training: Sharpen your skills and advance your expertise with our professional development programs.- Exclusive Discounts: Benefit from attractive employee discounts on different products and services.- Flexible Working Times: We offer flexible schedules to suit your lifestyle and personal commitments.- Free Parking: No one likes to start their day hunting for a spot - we've got guaranteed free parking spaces for everyone.- Monthly Gift Vouchers: Enjoy an extra amount each month for fuel, groceries, or entertainment.

A focus of our research are Engineered Living Materials (ELMs), an emergent class of materials from the combination of inert materials and living organism, with huge potential for sustainable innovation in different technological fields. Across the institute, materials scientists, synthetic biologists and biophysicists cooperate to understand living and inert matter, and to realize new materials with unprecedented functions from a synergistic interfacing.We are strongly linked to collaborative initiatives in the ELM field including the Leibniz ScienceCampus LifeMat, Living Therapeutic Materials, the Priority Program SPP2451 “Living Materials with Adaptive Functions”, and the MaterialVital Hub.As part of our ELM research community, we are seeking aPostdoctoral Researcher with expertise in Microbial Biophysics (f/m/d)with interest in the fundamental understanding of microbial communities within synthetic microenvironments. The candidate will be part of an interdisciplinary research team within the Department Dynamic Biomaterials at INM.Your roles:- Experimental research to understand microbial behaviour in confined spaces (synthetic hydrogels) and dynamic environments using imaging, microfluidics and molecular biology methods.- Scientific cooperation with researchers in materials science and synthetic biology at INM, and with external partners in bioanalytics/bioinformatics within running funded projects.- Compilation and presentation of research results in the form of progress reports and presentations at project meetings and scientific conferences.- Communication of research results within the scientific community at conferences and scientific events, and publication in scientific journals.- Co-supervision of students and doctoral researchers.- Support and promote the digitalization of ELM research in collaboration with dedicated experts in the group.Your profile:- PhD degree in biophysics/cell biology or related discipline.- Experience during your PhD or previous postdoctoral stay as experimental researcher in the field of microbial biophysics.- Interest in collaborative and interdisciplinary research challenges.- Self-driven and hands-on personality. Organization and prioritization skills.- Very good communication skills in English.We offer:- Work in an emergent research topic, with multiple opportunities to develop a competitive research profile.- An interdisciplinary research environment with complementary expertise and ready to share knowledge and support your work.- State-of-the-art infrastructure, including access to Core Facilities run by experts.- Access to a broad international network with vibrant scientific collaborators and exciting cooperation projects.- A highly professional and supportive working environment with an open and international culture.- A well-structured on-boarding process and clear responsibilities.- Transparent opportunities for career development.- Flexible working hours and mobile working opportunity.- A family-friendly working place.- A EG 13 TV-L position (full time). A part time position is also possible.The position is initially for 2 years.Interested?We look forward to your application! Please upload your CV and motivation letter, by October 15th, 2026 via the online application system. For further information on this position, please contact INM Scientific Director and Head of the Research Department Dynamic Biomaterials Prof. Dr. Aránzazu del Campo (aranzazu.delcampo@leibniz-inm.de ).The INM practices an open and appreciative corporate culture in which the existing diversity is promoted and lived. The institute is an equal opportunity employer with a certified family-friendly policy, and it provides offers for a better work-life balance, flextime, and mobile working. We promote professional opportunities for women and strongly encourage them to apply. Full time jobs can be generally divided. People with disabilities are expressly encouraged to apply and will be given priority if equally qualified.

We connect families with caring, qualified childcare professionals – and help nannies, babysitters, and tutors with international backgrounds find the right family match.We are currently looking for experienced nannies, babysitters, and tutors to work with families in Duisburg and the surrounding areas. If you speak English, French, Italian, or another widely spoken language, we’d love to hear from you!Your Responsibilities- Provide loving, attentive, and safe care for children.- Organize and structure daily routines with age-appropriate activities such as games, creative play, reading, or homework support.- Accompany children to and from school, nursery, or extracurricular activities.- Handle light, child-related housekeeping: meal prep, tidying play areas, laundry, etc.Your Profile- Experience with children or babies is essential. A background in education or childcare is a strong advantage.- You’re caring, empathetic, and genuinely enjoy working with children.- You’re reliable, organized, and flexible in your schedule.- You have a friendly, open, and professional attitude.- You speak English, French, Italian, or another common European language fluently.Why Join Us?- Bring your cultural diversity and language skills into a role where they truly make a difference.- Get matched with families that value your skills and background.- Be part of a trusted network of international childcare professionals.If you're passionate about childcare and want to make a difference in a family’s life, we’d love to hear from you!Apply now by submitting your CV directly on our website.We look forward to welcoming you to the Native Nanny community!

jobs.description: In order to fill a fixed-term position in part-time (29.8725 hours/week = 75%) at the earliest possible date, we are looking for 1ERC PhD Position in Low-Dimensional Topology and Knot Theory (m/f/x)Our research group works in low-dimensional topology and knot theory. We are interested in link homology theories, such as Heegaard Floer and Khovanov homology, and their application to open topological problems. Our work is supported by a Starting Grant (project number 101115822) from the European Research Council (ERC).Scope: part-timeDuration: fixed-term, 3 yearsStart: at the earliest possible dateApply by:  2027-11-16Your tasks:- Conduct individual and collaborative research projects related to my ERC Starting Grant, "Cut-and-paste Conjectures and Multicurves", through which the position is funded.- Publish high-quality papers in peer-reviewed journals.- Disseminate research through talks at international workshops and conferences.- Organize and actively participate in research group seminars.- (Optional) Be involved in the supervision of graduate students.- Contribute to fostering a collegial, inclusive, and respectful working environment where everyone is treated fairly, with dignity and respect.Your profile:- (Essential) Excellent Bachelor's Degree- (Essential) An outstanding master's degree (proof must be provided by the start date)- (Essential) Good communication skills in either English or German.- (Desirable) Demonstrable ability to plan and manage independent research.- (Desirable) Track record of presenting research at conferences, symposia, or meetings, commensurate with stage of career.- (Desirable) Strong publication record in peer-reviewed journals, commensurate with stage of career.- (Not essential) Working knowledge of a programming language (e.g., Python, C, C++).https://jobs.ruhr-uni-bochum.de/jobposting/35b0dea75b524defb04df97ed0d425817d0cebd30?ref=AfA (https://jobs.ruhr-uni-bochum.de/jobposting/35b0dea75b524defb04df97ed0d425817d0cebd30?ref=AfA)

jobs.occupation: IT Support Analyst - Global Helpdesk (18 month fixed‑term contract) (m/f/d) (Second-Level-Supporter/in)
jobs.description: Company DescriptionAbout usPassion for food. Hunger for tech. We make METRO digital.Today technology is driving the world. And at METRO.digital we are driving the technology for one of the leading international wholesalers specializing in food - METRO. From e-commerce to checkout, to delivery software, we work on a wide range of products to make each day a success for our customers and colleagues. With passion and ownership, we build the future of wholesale.Are you striving to create smart solutions for customers around the globe? You want to grow in a flexible environment? Let the right career opportunity find you and join us!Job DescriptionHow you will make an impactAt One Desk, you will not simply work in a traditional helpdesk. You will become part of a global support platform that combines local expertise with global standards. Together with colleagues from different countries, you will help shape modern support processes, evolve shared ways of working and contribute to reliable and scalable IT support for METRO.One Desk stands for a single entry point, connected collaboration and a consistent IT support experience.The Global Helpdesk is the first point of contact for IT-related questions, service requests and technical incidents. Incoming requests are logged, analyzed, resolved or routed to Global Process Operations or the relevant specialized product and support teams.One Desk combines country expertise and global capabilities with a clear focus on service standardization, automation, efficient incident management and continuous improvement.As our stores and logistics locations start early and remain active until late in the evening, the team provides service coverage through a structured shift model within the operating window from 5:30 a.m. to 10:30 p.m. and on Saturdays to 2p.m.Your Responsibilities- You are one of the first points of contact for IT-related questions and technical issues raised by our internal users.- You receive incoming requests by phone, through digital support channels and via remote support, record them centrally and assess the necessary resolution steps.- You analyze and resolve hardware and software issues using appropriate remote support tools.- You open, review, classify, prioritize and document incidents and service requests in our ticketing system.- You install, configure, support and troubleshoot Microsoft Windows, Microsoft 365, mobile devices, printers and various internal and external applications.- You work closely with local and global support, product and platform teams to ensure timely and sustainable issue resolution.- You support system enhancements, release changes and the rollout of new applications, end-user devices and hardware solutions.- You create and maintain documentation, knowledge articles and support materials and contribute to the development of a shared knowledge base.- You identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities, proactively propose solutions and contribute to the optimization and standardization of support processes.- You work in shifts and, together with the team, ensure User Service availability within the operating window from 5:30 a.m. to 10:30 p.m. and Saturdays until 2 p.m.QualificationsRequired key competencies and qualifications- You have completed vocational training in IT, for example as an IT Specialist for System Integration, IT Systems Technician, IT Systems Management Assistant, Information Technology Assistant or a comparable qualification. Alternatively, you have relevant professional experience.- You have practical experience in telephone-based or digital user support, a service desk or IT user support environment.- You have experience in the structured logging, processing and documentation of incidents and service requests in a ticketing system.- You have solid knowledge of Microsoft Windows operating systems and Microsoft Office or Microsoft 365.- Basic knowledge of common IT infrastructure components, such as clients, servers, Active Directory or Azure, Exchange, SCCM and firewalls, is an advantage.- You apply a methodical, structured and solution-oriented approach to troubleshooting.- You demonstrate strong customer and service orientation, communication skills and a professional manner.- You work independently, accurately and reliably while demonstrating a strong hands-on mentality.- You have strong organizational skills, set priorities effectively and maintain an overview when handling multiple requests.- You enjoy working in an international and agile environment and value collaboration across countries, teams and functions.- You are fluent in German and English, both written and spoken.Additional Information**What do we offer at METRO.digital?- Hybrid and agile work: thrive in a flexible, multicultural environment.At METRO.digital, we promote work-life balance through a hybrid working model. You’ll be part of self-organizing, multicultural teams that collaborate in an agile setup.- People development: when you grow so do we!We want you to become the best version of yourself with individual and company-wide programs and trainings for people development. Focused among other on development, leadership, appreciation ... it´s time to upskill your career.- Support with individual solutions: we are people-caring!We offer support whenever you need it - at every stage of your professional journey.Want to know more about all our benefits? Discover more here (https://metro.digital/about/life-at-metro) .Let´s connect soon. Apply for the role now!Position grade within our career framework: IT Support Analyst ISA2 (Md3).
